items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: someone said the other night was all wrong, said Benny Goodman, said he did the 'Bugle Blues'. Well, that wasn't so.

ctx.x: In fact, at that time, there was quite a lot of singers, and a lot of men sang the blues. At that time. At that time, you'll find out that -- 1918 -- of course that, someone said the other night was all wrong, said Benny

Goodman, said he did the "Bugle Blues". Well, that wasn't so. Jim Muir started the Bugle Blues in Europe, in 1917, during the war. See, one of his trumpets would play, (imitates trumpet), they did that in 1917, before Benny was born.
